description: Synthetic evaluation set for evidence-grounded case Q&A. All organizations, people, domains (.example) and addresses (RFC 5737 documentation ranges) are invented. Two cases are seeded so cross-case leakage can be measured.

primary.title: Örnek altyapı incelemesi (evaluation)
primary.purpose: Evaluate grounded answers over imported and synthetic fixture evidence.
primary.scope: ornek.example, Örnek A.Ş. and related synthetic material only.
